description: Delete a Cisco FTDv firewall service in two steps. Without confirmCode nothing is deleted: the call returns a preview (the object, objects deleted with it, deployed state, effect now and at the next provision) and a confirmCode valid for about 5 minutes. Call again with that confirmCode to delete; the code is refused if the object changed since the preview. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. A service used by a policy rule is refused as in use. The credentials the service references are deleted within seconds of the backend removing it, so a new service needs new credentials. The instances of a deployed service that are not deployed yet are removed at once, with their credentials; its deployed instances keep their credentials until the deletion is provisioned from the Alkira portal. If it is deployed, the delete only marks it for deletion: it keeps carrying traffic, with its name, until the deletion is provisioned from the Alkira portal. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

confirmCode.description: Code from the preview of this delete.

id.description: Id of the Cisco FTDv firewall service, as a string of digits such as "123" (not a number). The service_cisco_ftdv_get_* read tools and service_cisco_ftdv_create return it.

name: service_cisco_ftdv_delete
